abc.name: Artificial bee colony (ABCluster)
abc.en: Swarm-intelligence search over a population of SN=10 locally relaxed structures (food sources). In every cycle, employed bees create one neighbour per source by moving a random subset of atoms (bulk: also the lattice) along the difference to another, aligned source, v = x_i + phi (x_i - x_k) with phi in [-1,1], relax it and keep it only if it is lower in energy; onlooker bees repeat this on sources drawn with probability proportional to fitness, and scout bees replace sources that have not improved for limit=3 cycles with new random relaxed structures. This is the standard method of Karaboga & Basturk as adapted to clusters in ABCluster; the only additions are per-species Hungarian/Procrustes alignment before differencing, fractional-coordinate plus lattice-vector moves for variable-cell bulk, and re-seating of supported-cluster atoms that a move carries across the periodic vacuum towards the underside of the slab.
abc.zh: 人工蜂群算法：以 SN=10 个经局部弛豫的结构作为“蜜源”进行群体智能搜索。每一轮中，雇佣蜂为每个蜜源生成一个邻域解：将随机选取的一部分原子（体相还包括晶格）沿该蜜源与另一个经过对齐的蜜源之差移动，v = x_i + φ(x_i − x_k)，φ∈[−1,1]，局部弛豫后仅当能量更低时才替换原蜜源；观察蜂按适应度成比例地选择蜜源重复该操作；侦察蜂把连续 limit=3 轮未改进的蜜源替换为新的随机弛豫结构。这是 Karaboga 与 Basturk 提出、并由 ABCluster 推广到团簇的标准方法；此处仅增加了差分前按元素的匈牙利/Procrustes 结构对齐、可变晶胞体相中对分数坐标和晶格矢量的同时操作，以及把被移动穿过周期性真空层、移向基底下表面的负载团簇原子重新放回团簇上。
abc.ref: D. Karaboga & B. Basturk, J. Glob. Optim. 39, 459 (2007); J. Zhang & M. Dolg, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 17, 24173 (2015) (ABCluster)

aosbh.name: Adaptive operator selection basin hopping
aosbh.en: Basin hopping in which an online multi-armed bandit chooses every move from a category-aware portfolio of structure operators: global and local rattles, relocation of the least-bound atoms (ranked by NEP per-atom energies) to the most coordinated free sites or, for supported clusters, to apex sites on top of the cluster (turning wetting 2D rafts into 3D islands), cluster twists, rigid moves on the support or in the pore, unlike-atom swaps, cell strains, cut-and-splice with archived minima and fresh random structures. The bandit (discounted Thompson sampling with per-move ionic-step costs) credits each operator with success per ionic step (new best minimum, novel low-lying minimum, downhill hop), so effort shifts automatically to the moves that pay off on each system without per-benchmark tuning. Move amplitudes and the Metropolis temperature adapt online, relaxations that cannot reach Metropolis range are aborted early with a calibrated energy-tail predictor, and stagnating walkers restart from random or perturbed archived structures.
aosbh.zh: 在基跳（basin hopping）框架中，由在线多臂老虎机算法为每一步从一组按体系类别配置的结构算子中选择移动方式：全局与局部随机扰动、将结合最弱的原子（按 NEP 原子能量排序）迁移到配位最高的空位，对负载团簇还可迁移到团簇顶部的顶位（把润湿载体的二维筏状结构变为三维岛）、团簇扭转、载体或孔道中团簇的刚体移动、异种原子交换、晶胞应变、与存档低能结构的切割拼接以及全新的随机结构。该老虎机（带折扣并计入离子步代价的 Thompson 采样）按每个离子步的成功率（新的全局最优、新的低能极小、下坡跳跃）为各算子记功，从而无需针对具体体系调参即可自动把计算量转向在当前体系上有效的移动。移动幅度与 Metropolis 温度在线自适应；利用经校准的能量尾部预测器提前终止无法进入 Metropolis 接受范围的弛豫；搜索停滞时从随机结构或扰动后的存档极小重新开始。
aosbh.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Fialho, Da Costa, Schoenauer & Sebag, Ann. Math. Artif. Intell. 60, 25 (2010); Thierens, GECCO 2005, 1539; Xia et al., IJCAI 2015; Raj & Kalyani, arXiv:1707.09727 (2017); Deaven & Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); Rondina & Da Silva, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 53, 2282 (2013)

bh.name: Basin hopping
bh.en: Monte Carlo minimisation (basin hopping) with the standard GMIN settings: a Metropolis walk at kT = 0.1 eV on the relaxed energy surface. Every move displaces all search atoms uniformly within a sphere of radius step (bulk: plus a random symmetric cell strain, σ = 0.05), relaxes with L-BFGS and accepts with probability min(1, exp(−ΔE/kT)). Every 10 moves the step is multiplied by 1.1 or 0.9 depending on whether the acceptance ratio of those 10 moves is above 50% (bounded to 0.1–2 Å, initial 0.5 Å); detached cluster atoms are re-seated on the cluster surface. Literature parameters, not tuned.
bh.zh: 采用 GMIN 标准设置的蒙特卡洛极小化（盆地跳跃）：在弛豫后的能量面上进行 kT = 0.1 eV 的 Metropolis 行走。每次移动把所有搜索原子在半径为 step 的球内均匀随机位移（体相再加 σ = 0.05 的随机对称晶胞应变），用 L-BFGS 弛豫，并以 min(1, exp(−ΔE/kT)) 的概率接受。每 10 次移动根据这 10 次移动的接受率是否高于 50% 将步长乘以 1.1 或 0.9（限制在 0.1–2 Å，初值 0.5 Å）；团簇中脱离的原子被重新放回团簇表面。采用文献参数，未调参。
bh.ref: Li & Scheraga, PNAS 84, 6611 (1987); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997)

de.name: Differential evolution
de.en: Classic DE/rand/1/bin (Storn & Price) on a population of 20 locally relaxed structures (Lamarckian, as in the cluster code PDECO): for every target a mutant a + F(b - c) (F = 0.5) is built from three other random members, binomially crossed with the target atom by atom (CR = 0.9; for bulk the cell is one extra gene), relaxed, and it replaces the target only if it is lower in energy and not a duplicate of another member. Because atoms are permutable, the parents are first aligned per species by Hungarian assignment, plus Kabsch rotation for gas-phase clusters, lattice translations for supported and zeolite clusters, and canonical reduced cells with fractional coordinates for bulk. It is a standard baseline: the only additions are this alignment, duplicate rejection and the constraint repair needed for atoms.
de.zh: 经典的 DE/rand/1/bin 差分进化（Storn & Price），种群由 20 个经过局部弛豫的结构组成（拉马克式，与团簇优化程序 PDECO 相同）：对每个目标个体，用另外三个随机个体构造变异向量 a + F(b - c)（F = 0.5），再以原子为单位与目标个体做二项交叉（CR = 0.9；体相晶体的晶胞作为额外一个基因），弛豫后只有当能量更低且与其他个体不重复时才替换目标个体。由于同种原子可以互换，构造差分向量前先按元素用匈牙利算法匹配原子；气相团簇另做 Kabsch 旋转对齐，负载团簇和分子筛内团簇只做晶格平移，体相则使用约化晶胞中的分数坐标。这是一个标准基线方法，只为原子体系补充了对齐、去重和约束修复。
de.ref: R. Storn & K. Price, J. Glob. Optim. 11, 341 (1997); Z. Chen, X. Jiang, J. Li, S. Li & L. Wang, J. Comput. Chem. 34, 1046 (2013) (PDECO); Y.-Y. Zhang, W. Gao, S. Chen, H. Xiang & X.-G. Gong, Comput. Mater. Sci. 98, 51 (2015) (IM2ODE)

egbh.name: Energy-guided basin hopping
egbh.en: Energy-guided basin hopping (EGBH) is a basin-hopping walk whose moves are steered by the per-atom energies that NEP89 returns for free with every evaluation. Weakly bound atoms (high site energy relative to their own species) are moved preferentially to dynamic-lattice candidate sites (apex sites above bonded triangles, bridge and atop sites of the cluster, support or crystal) that are ranked by an online, element-resolved site-energy model learned from the potential's own energy decomposition; alloys and compounds also get model-guided swaps and an exchange scan that ranks all swaps of the current minimum by their single-point energies. Tabu lists, energy-weighted shakes, twists, rigid and strain moves and fresh random structures diversify the search, and the move probabilities adapt online to each move's energy gain per ionic step. New compared with standard basin hopping and dynamic lattice searching is that the ML potential's site energies decide both which atoms to move and, via the learned model, where atoms of each element want to sit.
egbh.zh: 能量引导盆地跳跃（EGBH）是一种盆地跳跃随机游走，其移动由 NEP89 每次计算时免费给出的单原子能量引导。弱束缚原子（位点能量相对于同种元素偏高）被优先移动到动态晶格候选位点（团簇、载体或晶体上键合三角形上方的顶点位、桥位和顶位），这些位点由一个在线学习、按元素区分的位点能量模型排序，该模型直接从势函数自身的能量分解中学习；合金和化合物还使用模型引导的异种原子交换，以及用单点能量对当前极小结构的所有交换进行排序的交换扫描。禁忌表、能量加权扰动、扭转、刚体移动、晶胞应变和全新随机结构保证搜索的多样性，各类移动的概率根据其每个离子步带来的能量收益在线自适应调整。与标准盆地跳跃和动态晶格搜索相比，其创新之处在于用机器学习势的位点能量同时决定移动哪些原子，并通过所学模型判断每种元素的原子倾向于占据哪些位置。
egbh.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004) [dynamic lattice searching]; Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) [moving the highest-energy atoms to the best surface sites]; Rossi & Ferrando, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 21, 084208 (2009) [exchange moves for nanoalloys]; Behler & Parrinello, PRL 98, 146401 (2007) [atom-centred radial descriptors]; Glover, ORSA J. Comput. 1, 190 (1989) [tabu search]

ga.name: Genetic algorithm (cut-and-splice)
ga.en: Faithful baseline implementation, with literature parameter values, of the standard Lamarckian cluster genetic algorithm (Deaven-Ho / Birmingham Cluster GA / ASE-GA): a population of 20 locally relaxed structures evolves in steady state, with parents chosen by roulette-wheel selection on Johnston's tanh fitness of the normalised energy (plus the ASE-GA pairing and duplicate history penalties). Children are made by Deaven-Ho cut-and-splice crossover (a vertical cut for supported clusters with registry-preserving alignment; for bulk the Abraham-Probert periodic cut in fractional coordinates with lattice heredity) or, with probability 0.2, by standard mutations (rattle, mirror, twist, atom relocation, permutation of unlike atoms; cell strain for bulk). Every child is relaxed with L-BFGS and replaces the worst member if it is lower and not a duplicate (energy + fingerprint); after 10 generations' worth of candidates (200) without a new best structure, the GA restarts from a new random population.
ga.zh: 标准拉马克式团簇遗传算法（Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接、伯明翰团簇遗传算法 BCGA 与 ASE-GA）的忠实基线实现，采用文献标准参数：由 20 个经局部弛豫的结构组成的种群以稳态方式进化，父代通过轮盘赌选择，适应度为 Johnston 的归一化能量 tanh 函数（并带有 ASE-GA 的配对次数与重复结构惩罚）。子代由 Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接交叉产生（负载团簇采用垂直于表面的切面并保持吸附位点对齐；体相采用 Abraham-Probert 在分数坐标下的周期性切割并继承加权平均的晶格），或以 0.2 的概率由标准变异产生（随机扰动、镜像、半团簇扭转、原子重定位、异种原子置换；体相另有晶胞应变）。每个子代都用 L-BFGS 局部弛豫，若能量低于种群中最差个体且不与已有结构重复（能量加指纹判据）则将其替换；若连续 10 代（200 个候选结构）未找到更优结构，则以新的随机种群重新开始。
ga.ref: D. M. Deaven & K. M. Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); R. L. Johnston, Dalton Trans. 2003, 4193 (Birmingham Cluster GA); L. B. Vilhelmsen & B. Hammer, J. Chem. Phys. 141, 044711 (2014) (ASE-GA); N. L. Abraham & M. I. J. Probert, Phys. Rev. B 73, 224104 (2006) (periodic cut for crystals)

gofee.name: GOFEE (Gaussian-process surrogate search)
gofee.en: GOFEE trains a Gaussian-process surrogate (double-Gaussian kernel on a radial + angular distribution fingerprint, repulsive prior) on every NEP energy obtained so far. Each iteration it generates 30 candidates from a population of 10 low-energy structures (random structures, rattle, cut-and-splice, permutation), relaxes them for free in the surrogate's lower confidence bound mu - 2 sigma, and spends real ionic steps only on the most promising one (one single point plus one force-driven 'dual point'). This is the standard published method (Bisbo & Hammer); the only additions are an occasional short true NEP relaxation of the best unrelaxed population member, needed because a hit requires an energy within 0.02 eV of a true NEP minimum, and caps on the training set and surrogate steps to bound the wall time.
gofee.zh: GOFEE 用迄今得到的所有 NEP 能量训练一个高斯过程代理模型（基于径向+角度分布指纹的双高斯核，并带排斥先验）。每次迭代从 10 个低能结构组成的种群中生成 30 个候选结构（随机结构、扰动、切割拼接、元素置换），在代理模型的置信下界 mu - 2 sigma 上免费弛豫，只对最有希望的一个结构花费真实离子步（一次单点计算加一个沿受力方向的“对偶点”）。这是 Bisbo 与 Hammer 发表的标准方法；唯一的补充是偶尔对种群中能量最低且尚未弛豫的结构做一次简短的真实 NEP 弛豫（因为命中要求能量在真实 NEP 极小值 0.02 eV 以内），以及为控制墙钟时间而对训练集大小和代理弛豫步数设的上限。
gofee.ref: M. K. Bisbo and B. Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 086102 (2020); M. K. Bisbo and B. Hammer, Phys. Rev. B 105, 245404 (2022)

growth.name: Cut-and-regrow (learned-site growth)
growth.en: A Metropolis walk over relaxed minima whose only structural move is cut-and-regrow: k atoms are removed (those with the highest NEP per-atom energy, a random contiguous fragment, or the least-coordinated ones) and regrown one by one at geometrically enumerated hollow, bridge and atop sites on the remaining cluster, the support or zeolite wall, or inside the periodic cell (bulk: plus cell strain; alloys/compounds: plus energy-guided species swaps). What is new: the sites are ranked by a per-species ridge model of NEP per-atom energies that is refitted on the fly from relaxation start and end points at no extra ionic steps; the cut size grows adaptively on stagnation up to about n/3 before a random restart; and each local relaxation is two-stage, finished to full accuracy only if the trial can still pass the pre-drawn Metropolis threshold.
growth.zh: 在弛豫后的局部极小之间进行 Metropolis 随机行走，唯一的结构移动是“切除-再生长”：先移除 k 个原子（NEP 单原子能量最高的原子、随机的空间连续片段或配位数最低的原子），再将它们逐个重新生长到几何枚举的空位（三原子穴位、桥位、顶位）上——位置可以在剩余团簇上、载体或分子筛孔壁上，或在周期性晶胞内（体相同时施加随机晶胞应变；合金/化合物另加按能量引导的元素交换）。创新之处：候选位点由一个按元素区分的岭回归模型排序，该模型拟合 NEP 单原子能量，并利用每次弛豫起点和终点的数据在线更新，不消耗额外离子步；停滞时切除数 k 自适应增大至约 n/3，之后随机重启；每次局部弛豫分两阶段进行，只有当试探结构仍可能通过预先抽取的 Metropolis 阈值时才弛豫到完全收敛。
growth.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping); Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 11401 (2004) (dynamic lattice searching); Rondina & Da Silva, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 53, 2282 (2013) (revised basin hopping); Deaven & Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995) (cut-and-splice); Northby, J. Chem. Phys. 87, 6166 (1987) and Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) (cluster growth sequences); Pickard & Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011) (AIRSS random restarts)

memetic.name: Adaptive memetic algorithm (GA + BH chains)
memetic.en: A small niched population of relaxed structures (seeded with only two random structures and filled by offspring) is evolved by three competing operators: Deaven-Ho cut-and-splice (registry-preserving on surfaces) or lattice heredity (bulk), short self-terminating Metropolis basin-hopping chains started from good, not yet exhausted members, and new random structures, half of which are grown atom by atom at well-bonded sites. The ionic-step budget is shared among the operators online by credit assignment: each earns a rank-based reward only for minima that are new to an archive of all minima seen so far and is chosen with probability proportional to its forgotten reward per ionic step, so the search behaves like a GA, a basin hopping or a random search depending on which currently pays off. A second (meta-Lamarckian) credit level selects the BH move: adaptive shake, twist, rigid move, lattice strain, unlike-atom swap (best of 4 trial swaps by unrelaxed energy) or relocation of the highest-energy atoms to the best-bonded of 48 candidate sites, which on supports and in pores include sites next to host atoms so that atoms can wet the support. Fingerprint niching and elitist immigration after stagnation keep the population diverse.
memetic.zh: 自适应模因算法：一个小规模、带小生境的已弛豫结构种群（仅以两个随机结构起步，其余由子代填充）由三种相互竞争的算子演化：Deaven-Ho 剪切拼接交叉（表面体系保持吸附位点配准）或晶格遗传（体相）；从优良且尚未“耗尽”的个体出发、可自行终止的短程 Metropolis 盆地跳跃链；以及新的随机结构，其中一半在成键良好的位点上逐原子生长得到。离子步预算通过信用分配在线分给各算子：只有产生“已见极小值档案”中没有的新极小值时，算子才获得基于排名的奖励，并按其带遗忘的“每离子步奖励”成比例地被选中，因此搜索会根据当前哪种策略更有效而表现为遗传算法、盆地跳跃或随机搜索。第二层（元拉马克式）信用分配选择盆地跳跃的移动类型：自适应扰动、扭转、刚性移动、晶格应变、异种原子交换（4 次试交换中取未弛豫能量最低者），或把能量最高的原子迁移到 48 个候选位点中成键最好的位置——在载体上或孔道内，候选位点也包括基底原子旁的位置，使原子可以铺展到载体上。指纹小生境和停滞后的精英保留式移民维持种群多样性。
memetic.ref: P. Moscato, Caltech C3P Report 826 (1989); Y.-S. Ong & A. J. Keane, IEEE Trans. Evol. Comput. 8, 99 (2004); D. M. Deaven & K. M. Ho, Phys. Rev. Lett. 75, 288 (1995); A. R. Oganov & C. W. Glass, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 244704 (2006); D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997)

metabh.name: Metadynamics-biased basin hopping
metabh.en: Basin hopping whose Metropolis test uses E + V(s) instead of E: s is an energy-agnostic structural descriptor of each local minimum (coordination numbers per element pair, Steinhardt q4/q6, size and shape of clusters, substrate contacts and height of supported clusters, volume per atom of crystals) and V is a well-tempered metadynamics bias made of broad Gaussians (each covering a whole funnel of similar minima) deposited at the visited minima, so structural regions where the walker has lingered are gradually filled and it is pushed towards unexplored structure types, while the true NEP energy alone defines the best structure. Moves combine random displacements with an adaptive step, relocation of high per-atom-energy atoms to well-coordinated hollow sites, unlike-atom swaps, rigid moves of supported or confined clusters and occasional random-structure jumps; trial relaxations stop early once an online-calibrated estimate of the remaining energy drop shows that they cannot pass the pre-drawn Metropolis threshold. What is new is the history-dependent bias over collective variables, borrowed from free-energy metadynamics, applied to the discrete walk between minima of basin hopping.
metabh.zh: 在盆地跳跃（basin hopping）的 Metropolis 判据中用 E + V(s) 代替 E：s 是每个局部极小结构的与能量无关的结构描述符（按元素对的配位数、Steinhardt q4/q6、团簇的尺寸与形状、负载团簇与基底的接触及高度、晶体的每原子体积），V 是在已访问极小处沉积宽高斯函数（每个覆盖由相似极小构成的整个漏斗）构成的 well-tempered 元动力学偏置势，从而逐步填平游走者长时间停留的结构区域，把它推向尚未探索的结构类型，而最优结构仍只由真实的 NEP 能量决定。移动包括步长自适应的随机位移、把单原子能量高的原子移到配位良好的空位（hollow site）、异种原子交换、负载或限域团簇的刚性移动以及偶尔的随机结构跳跃；当在线标定的剩余能量下降估计表明某次试探弛豫已不可能通过预先抽取的 Metropolis 阈值时，提前终止该弛豫。创新之处在于把自由能计算中作用于集体变量的元动力学历史依赖偏置引入到盆地跳跃在极小之间的离散游走中。
metabh.ref: Laio & Parrinello, PNAS 99, 12562 (2002); Barducci, Bussi & Parrinello, PRL 100, 020603 (2008); Iwamatsu & Okabe, Chem. Phys. Lett. 399, 396 (2004); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Steinhardt, Nelson & Ronchetti, PRB 28, 784 (1983); cf. energy-landscape paving, Hansmann & Wille, PRL 88, 068105 (2002)

mh.name: Minima hopping
mh.en: Minima hopping (Goedecker 2004): from the current local minimum a short molecular-dynamics run with Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities at temperature T crosses a barrier, is stopped at the second potential-energy minimum along the trajectory and is relaxed with L-BFGS; T is raised (x1.1) when the walker falls back into the same or an already visited minimum and lowered (/1.1) when a new minimum is found, and every different minimum is accepted if its energy is less than Ediff above the current one, with Ediff self-adjusting (x0.98 on acceptance, /0.98 on rejection) so that about half of them are accepted. As in the later versions of the Goedecker group, the initial velocities are first softened towards low-curvature directions with up to 20 gradient-only dimer iterations (Schoenborn et al. 2009), the MD time step adapts to energy conservation, and bulk crystals use variable-cell escape dynamics in which the lattice vectors move as well (Amsler & Goedecker 2010), followed by a variable-cell relaxation and Minkowski reduction of the cell. It is a faithful baseline with the ASE / literature default parameters (T0 = 1000 K, Ediff0 = 0.5 eV, mdmin = 2); only safety measures were added: escapes that break energy conservation or squash the cell are stopped early and counted as too hot (T is lowered), and atoms that detach from a cluster or adsorbate are put back before the relaxation.
mh.zh: 极小跳跃法（Goedecker 2004）：从当前局部极小出发，以温度 T 下的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼速度进行一段短的分子动力学模拟以越过势垒，在轨迹上遇到第二个势能极小时停止，再用 L-BFGS 弛豫；若落回同一个或已访问过的极小则升高 T（×1.1），找到新极小则降低 T（÷1.1）；与当前不同的极小只要能量比当前高出不到 Ediff 就被接受，Ediff 自适应调整（接受时 ×0.98，拒绝时 ÷0.98），使大约一半的极小被接受。与 Goedecker 课题组后来的版本一样，初始速度先经过最多 20 次只用梯度的二聚体迭代向低曲率方向软化（Schönborn 等 2009），MD 时间步长根据能量守恒情况自适应调整；体相晶体采用晶格矢量也随之运动的可变晶胞逃逸动力学（Amsler & Goedecker 2010），随后进行可变晶胞弛豫并对晶胞做 Minkowski 约化。这是采用 ASE/文献默认参数（T0 = 1000 K、Ediff0 = 0.5 eV、mdmin = 2）的忠实基线实现，仅加入了安全措施：破坏能量守恒或把晶胞压扁的逃逸会被提前终止并视为过热（降低 T），脱离团簇或吸附物的原子在弛豫前被放回原处。
mh.ref: S. Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 9911 (2004) (minima hopping); S. E. Schoenborn, S. Goedecker, S. Roy & A. R. Oganov, J. Chem. Phys. 130, 144108 (2009) (softening); M. Amsler & S. Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 133, 224104 (2010) (variable-cell minima hopping); A. A. Peterson, Top. Catal. 57, 40 (2014) (ASE MinimaHopping, default parameters); M. Krummenacher et al., SoftwareX 25, 101632 (2024) (minimahopping reference code: time-step feedback, softening details)

pso.name: Particle swarm optimisation (CALYPSO)
pso.en: CALYPSO-style particle swarm optimisation: a swarm of 20-30 locally relaxed structures moves by the PSO velocity update towards each particle's personal best and the best of its nearest neighbours in fingerprint space (local PSO, inertia weight decreasing from 0.9 to 0.4, c1 = c2 = 2, velocity clamping), while 40% of every generation are fresh random structures. As in CALYPSO, random crystals are built with space-group symmetry and random gas-phase clusters with point-group symmetry, near-duplicate structures are removed by a fingerprint similarity check, and the swarm restarts after 10 generations without a better global best. The only addition is an alignment step for permutable atoms (per-species Hungarian assignment, plus Kabsch rotation for free clusters) before every velocity update.
pso.zh: CALYPSO 风格的粒子群优化：由 20-30 个局部弛豫结构组成的粒子群按 PSO 速度更新公式移动，趋向每个粒子的个体最优和其在指纹空间中最近邻粒子的最优结构（局部 PSO，惯性权重由 0.9 线性降至 0.4，c1 = c2 = 2，速度限幅），每一代另有 40% 为新的随机结构。与 CALYPSO 一致，随机晶体按空间群对称性生成，随机气相团簇按点群对称性生成，借助指纹相似性判据剔除近似重复的结构，连续 10 代全局最优不再改进时重启粒子群。唯一的补充是针对可置换原子的对齐步骤：每次速度更新前按元素做匈牙利算法匹配，自由团簇还额外做 Kabsch 旋转对齐。
pso.ref: Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, Phys. Rev. B 82, 094116 (2010); Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, Comput. Phys. Commun. 183, 2063 (2012); J. Lv, Y. Wang, L. Zhu, Y. Ma, J. Chem. Phys. 137, 084104 (2012); Y. Wang et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 27, 203203 (2015)

ptbh.name: Parallel-tempering basin hopping
ptbh.en: Basin-hopping parallel tempering (BHPT, also called replica-exchange basin hopping): six standard basin-hopping walkers (the move set, L-BFGS quench and adaptive step size of the BH baseline) run at temperatures on a fixed geometric ladder kT = 0.05-0.5 eV, share one ionic-step budget and take one BH step each in turn. After every round, with probability 0.5, neighbouring temperatures swap their current minima with the replica-exchange criterion min(1, exp[(1/kT_i - 1/kT_j)(E_i - E_j)]), so that low-lying minima found by the hot, freely exploring walkers migrate down to the cold walkers, which refine them. This is the standard method of Strodel et al. (GMIN keyword BHPT) with literature parameter values; the only changes are the serial interleaving of the replicas on a single budget, a per-temperature step size adapted from the acceptance of the last 10 moves, and, for variable-cell bulk, Minkowski reduction of the lattice before each cell-strain move and restarting a replica whose cell relaxation aborted.
ptbh.zh: 基于并行回火的盆地跳跃（BHPT，又称副本交换盆地跳跃）：六个标准盆地跳跃行走者（与 BH 基线相同的移动方式、L-BFGS 局部弛豫和自适应步长）分别处于 kT = 0.05–0.5 eV 的固定几何温度阶梯上，共享同一个离子步预算，轮流各走一步。每轮结束后以 0.5 的概率让相邻温度的副本按副本交换判据 min(1, exp[(1/kT_i − 1/kT_j)(E_i − E_j)]) 交换各自当前的局部极小，使高温副本自由探索时发现的低能极小逐步传递到低温副本中进一步精修。这是 Strodel 等人提出的标准方法（GMIN 关键字 BHPT），采用文献中的参数值；唯一的改动是各副本在单进程中交替运行并共享预算、每个温度的步长根据最近 10 次移动的接受率自适应调整，以及对变胞体相在每次晶胞应变移动前做 Minkowski 晶格约化、并在晶胞弛豫中止时让该副本从新的随机结构重新开始。
ptbh.ref: Strodel, Lee, Whittleston & Wales, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 132, 13300 (2010) (basin-hopping parallel tempering, GMIN keyword BHPT); Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping); Swendsen & Wang, Phys. Rev. Lett. 57, 2607 (1986) and Hukushima & Nemoto, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 65, 1604 (1996) (replica exchange / parallel tempering)

race.name: Racing basin hopping
race.en: Basin hopping in which every local relaxation races against the Metropolis acceptance threshold: the Metropolis random number is drawn before relaxing, and the L-BFGS relaxation is advanced one iteration at a time. It is abandoned as soon as an optimistic lower bound of its final energy shows that the trial will be rejected anyway, and it stops at a loose force threshold when the trial is surely accepted but cannot become a new global best. The bound is calibrated online by conformal prediction, separately for random restarts and for local moves, on a random 10% of trials that are relaxed in full, which keeps the probability of a wrong abort at or below 10% for any energy scale. The steps saved on losing trials pay for bold moves: cut-and-regrow of high-energy atoms at well-coordinated sites, swaps, rigid moves of supported clusters and raced random restarts.
race.zh: 一种盆地跳跃（basin hopping）方法，其中每一次局部弛豫都与 Metropolis 接受阈值进行“竞速”：Metropolis 判据所用的随机数在弛豫开始之前就已抽取，L-BFGS 弛豫则逐步推进、每次只走一步迭代。一旦最终能量的乐观下界表明该试探无论如何都会被拒绝，弛豫就立即中止；如果试探必然被接受、但不可能成为新的全局最优，则在较宽松的力收敛阈值处提前停止。该下界通过保形预测（conformal prediction）在线校准，随机重启与局部移动各自单独校准：随机抽取 10% 的试探做完整弛豫作为校准样本，因此无论体系的能量尺度如何，错误中止的概率都不超过 10%。在必败试探上节省下来的步数被用于更大胆的移动：在高配位空位处“切除再生长”高能原子、交换不同元素原子、对负载团簇做刚性平移转动，以及参与竞速的随机重启。
race.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997); Maron & Moore, NIPS 6 (1994) and Artif. Intell. Rev. 11, 193 (1997); Jamieson & Talwalkar, AISTATS (2016); Li et al., JMLR 18, 1 (2018); Vovk, Gammerman & Shafer, Algorithmic Learning in a Random World, Springer (2005); Iwamatsu & Okabe, Chem. Phys. Lett. 399, 396 (2004); Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004)

rs.name: Random search
rs.en: Ab initio random structure searching (AIRSS) style sampling: independent random structures (with a random cell for bulk crystals) are generated inside the search region with the shared minimum-distance and connectivity constraints, and each is relaxed with L-BFGS. There is no memory between trials, so its efficiency is the probability of landing in the global-minimum basin per ionic step; it is the reference for how much a search strategy gains over pure sampling.
rs.zh: 仿照 AIRSS（从头随机结构搜索）的随机采样：在搜索区域内按统一的最小原子间距与连通性约束独立生成随机结构（体相同时随机生成晶胞），每个结构用 L-BFGS 弛豫。各次试验之间没有记忆，因此其效率就是每个离子步落入全局最优盆地的概率；它是衡量搜索策略相对纯随机采样收益的参照。
rs.ref: Pickard & Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011)

sa.name: Simulated annealing (MD)
sa.en: Classic simulated annealing carried out with molecular dynamics: every cycle starts from a fresh random structure, heats it to 2500 K with a Langevin thermostat and cools it geometrically to 300 K over 3000 MD steps (2 fs time step, shorter for light elements), then quenches it to the nearest local minimum with L-BFGS; independent cycles are repeated until the budget is spent. Bulk crystals are annealed at zero pressure with a Berendsen barostat and quenched with a variable-cell relaxation. Nothing is new: it is a faithful baseline with standard literature parameters; only safety measures were added (an elastic container that pulls evaporated fragments back to the cluster, a speed cap against MD explosions) and the last anneal is shortened to fit the remaining budget.
sa.zh: 经典的分子动力学模拟退火：每个循环从一个新的随机结构出发，用朗之万恒温器加热到 2500 K，并在 3000 个 MD 步内（时间步长 2 fs，轻元素相应缩短）按几何级数降温到 300 K，随后用 L-BFGS 淬火到最近的局部极小；各循环相互独立，重复进行直到预算用完。体相晶体在零压下用 Berendsen 恒压器退火，并以可变晶胞弛豫淬火。该方法没有新的改动，是采用文献标准参数的忠实基线实现；仅加入了安全措施（把蒸发出去的碎片拉回团簇的弹性容器、防止 MD 发散的速度上限），并把最后一次退火缩短以适应剩余预算。
sa.ref: S. Kirkpatrick, C. D. Gelatt & M. P. Vecchi, Science 220, 671 (1983); R. Biswas & D. R. Hamann, Phys. Rev. B 34, 895 (1986) (MD annealing of Si clusters); H. J. C. Berendsen et al., J. Chem. Phys. 81, 3684 (1984) (barostat); B. Leimkuhler & C. Matthews, Appl. Math. Res. Express 2013, 34 (BAOAB Langevin integrator)

softmode.name: Soft-mode guided hopping
softmode.en: Basin hopping whose trial moves follow the softest collective vibrational modes of the current minimum instead of random displacements of all atoms. The modes cost no energy evaluations: they come from a bond-stiffness model Hessian built from covalent radii (exponential pair springs; substrate atoms act as anchors and bulk crystals include the six cell-strain components), and the same model Hessian preconditions the L-BFGS relaxations. The jump amplitude adapts online so that 65% of jumps escape into a new basin, alloys add unlike-atom swaps with a self-tuned probability, and Metropolis acceptance with restarts after stagnation is kept from basin hopping. New is the use of free model-Hessian soft modes, instead of the costly true-Hessian softening of USPEX softmutation or minima hopping, together with escape-rate control and model-Hessian preconditioning.
softmode.zh: 一种盆地跳跃（basin hopping）方法：试探步不再随机扰动所有原子，而是沿当前极小结构最软的集体振动模式移动。这些模式不消耗任何能量计算：它们来自由共价半径构建的键刚度模型 Hessian（指数型原子对弹簧；衬底原子作为锚点，体相晶体额外包含六个晶胞应变分量），同一模型 Hessian 还用作 L-BFGS 局部弛豫的预条件子。跳跃幅度在线自适应，使 65% 的跳跃逃逸到新的盆地；合金体系额外使用概率自调节的异种原子交换，并保留盆地跳跃的 Metropolis 接受准则和停滞后从随机结构重启。其新颖之处在于：使用零代价的模型 Hessian 软模（代替 USPEX 软模突变或极小跳跃中代价高昂的真实 Hessian 软化），并结合逃逸率控制和模型 Hessian 预条件。
softmode.ref: A. O. Lyakhov, A. R. Oganov & M. Valle, Comput. Phys. Commun. 181, 1623 (2010) [softmutation]; M. Schoenborn, S. Goedecker, S. Roy & A. R. Oganov, J. Chem. Phys. 130, 144108 (2009) [minima-hopping softening]; G. Henkelman & H. Jonsson, J. Chem. Phys. 111, 7010 (1999) [dimer]; R. Lindh et al., Chem. Phys. Lett. 241, 423 (1995) [model Hessian]; D. Packwood et al., J. Chem. Phys. 144, 164109 (2016) [preconditioning]; A. R. Atilgan et al., Biophys. J. 80, 505 (2001) [anisotropic network model]; D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]

ssw.name: Stochastic surface walking
ssw.en: Metropolis Monte Carlo walk between local minima in which every trial move is a smooth climb out of the current basin: Gaussian bias potentials (width 0.6 Å, up to 10 per move) are added one after another along a random direction that a biased dimer rotation softens towards low-curvature modes, the structure is relaxed on the biased surface after each addition, and finally all biases are removed and the structure is fully relaxed and accepted or rejected at 1000 K. Standard SSW of Shang & Liu with literature parameters (crystals: atoms and lattice in one generalised coordinate set as in LASP); every force call of the dimer rotations, the climb and the relaxations counts as an ionic step.
ssw.zh: 在局域极小之间进行 Metropolis 蒙特卡洛行走，每一次试探移动都从当前势阱中平滑地“爬出”：沿一个随机方向（用偏置二聚体旋转向低曲率的软模修正）逐个加入高斯偏置势（宽度 0.6 Å，每步最多 10 个），每加一个就在偏置势能面上做局域弛豫，最后去掉全部偏置势并完全弛豫到新的极小，再按 1000 K 的 Metropolis 准则接受或拒绝。这是采用文献参数的标准 SSW 方法（Shang 和 Liu），晶体按 LASP 的方式把原子和晶格自由度放在同一组广义坐标中；二聚体旋转、爬坡和弛豫中的每一次力计算都计为一个离子步。
ssw.ref: C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 9, 1838 (2013) (SSW); C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 2215 (2012) (BP-CBD biased dimer rotation/translation); X.-J. Zhang, C. Shang, Z.-P. Liu, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 9, 3252 (2013); C. Shang, X.-J. Zhang, Z.-P. Liu, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 16, 17845 (2014) (SSW-crystal); S.-D. Huang, C. Shang, P.-L. Kang, X.-J. Zhang, Z.-P. Liu, WIREs Comput. Mol. Sci. 9, e1415 (2019) (LASP)

surr.name: Online-surrogate pre-relaxation BH
surr.en: Basin hopping in which a cheap surrogate potential (a linear moment-tensor/MEAM-like model of per-atom energies, frozen host atoms included as neighbours) is refitted on the fly by ridge regression to the energies, forces and virials of every NEP step of the run itself - no pretrained data. Each cycle relaxes a batch of candidate moves (perturbations, relocations, crossover, swaps, random structures) on the surrogate for free, discards those that fall back into already visited basins (fingerprints) or into model holes, and spends NEP steps only on the lowest predicted new minimum. New: the NEP relaxation itself is surrogate-Newton - every ionic step jumps to the trust-region minimum of the surrogate corrected to the current NEP energy and forces (cell included for bulk), so a minimum costs a few ionic steps instead of tens; the screening step size is tuned to the surrogate basin-escape rate, and the method falls back to unscreened moves when the online-measured surrogate error is large or a wall-time governor triggers.
surr.zh: 在基跳(basin hopping)框架中在线拟合一个廉价的代理势(线性矩张量/类MEAM的原子能量模型，冻结的基底原子作为近邻参与描述)，用岭回归拟合本次运行中每一个NEP离子步的能量、力和维里，不使用任何预训练数据。每个循环先在代理势上免费弛豫一批候选结构(扰动、原子重定位、交叉、元素互换、随机结构)，用指纹剔除落回已访问能谷的候选以及落入模型“空洞”的候选，只把预测能量最低的新极小值交给NEP弛豫。创新点：NEP弛豫本身采用“代理牛顿”步——每个离子步都跳到经当前NEP能量和力校正后的代理势在信赖域内的极小点(体相同时优化晶胞)，因此每个极小值只需少量离子步而不是数十步；筛选步长按代理势上的逃逸能谷比例自适应，当在线测得的代理误差过大或墙钟时间调控器触发时，自动退回不经筛选的普通移动。
surr.ref: Wales & Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Shapeev, Multiscale Model. Simul. 14, 1153 (2016) [moment tensor potentials]; Baskes, Phys. Rev. B 46, 2727 (1992) [MEAM angular densities]; Jacobsen, Jorgensen & Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 026102 (2018) [on-the-fly learned structure search]; Kolsbjerg, Peterson & Hammer, Phys. Rev. B 97, 195424 (2018) [NN-accelerated global optimisation]; Podryabinkin, Tikhonov, Shapeev & Oganov, Phys. Rev. B 99, 064114 (2019) [MLIP pre-relaxation in crystal structure prediction]; del Rio, Mortensen & Jacobsen, Phys. Rev. B 100, 104103 (2019) [GPMin surrogate-accelerated local optimisation]; Bisbo & Hammer, Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 086102 (2020) [GOFEE, contrasted]

symm.name: Symmetry-seeded search
symm.en: Two-armed search whose exploration arm generates random but symmetric starting structures with self-written group-theory code: gas-phase clusters get a random point group whose orbits (centre, rotation axes, mirror planes, general positions) are filled by a knapsack partition of the exact composition, supported clusters a vertical Cn/Cnv group centred on a top, bridge or hollow site, zeolite guests symmetric motifs inside the pore, and bulk crystals Wyckoff orbits of 37 space groups with a random supercell; for alloys and ionic compositions symmetric 'skeletons' are decorated with species by core-shell, random or electronegativity-contrast rules. The exploitation arm is a Metropolis basin-hopping walker (adaptive steps, cell strain, unlike-atom swaps and, for clusters, a move that projects the structure onto its detected approximate point group) that jumps to better seeds and restarts on stagnation. Discounted probability-matching bandits split the effort between seeding and hopping, and among symmetric, C1 and plain random seeds, by the rate of new low-lying minima per ionic step. New is the combination of AIRSS/PyXtal/CALYPSO-style symmetric random seeding, in one code for clusters, supported clusters, zeolite guests and crystals, with bandit-balanced basin hopping, plus the skeleton decoration and the symmetrise move.
symm.zh: 对称性播种搜索包含两个分支。探索分支用自编的群论代码生成随机但具有对称性的初始结构：气相团簇随机选取点群，并以精确组成的背包划分填充其各类轨道（中心、旋转轴、镜面与一般位置）；负载团簇采用以顶位、桥位或空位为轴心的竖直 Cn/Cnv 点群；分子筛客体团簇在孔道内放置对称结构单元；体相晶体填充 37 个空间群的 Wyckoff 轨道并随机扩胞；对合金和离子型组成，先生成对称“骨架”，再按核壳、随机或电负性差最大化规则分配元素。利用分支是 Metropolis 基跳行走者（自适应步长、晶胞应变、异种原子交换，以及对团簇将结构投影到其检测出的近似点群的“对称化”移动），遇到更优的种子结构时跳转过去，停滞时从新种子重启。带折扣的概率匹配老虎机按每个离子步获得新低能极小的速率，在播种与跳跃之间、以及对称、C1 与普通随机种子之间分配计算量。创新之处在于把 AIRSS/PyXtal/CALYPSO 式的对称随机播种在同一套代码中统一用于团簇、负载团簇、分子筛客体与晶体，并与老虎机平衡的基跳相结合，另加骨架装饰与对称化移动。
symm.ref: C. J. Pickard & R. J. Needs, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 23, 053201 (2011) (AIRSS); S. Fredericks, K. Parrish, D. Sayre & Q. Zhu, Comput. Phys. Commun. 261, 107810 (2021) (PyXtal); Y. Wang, J. Lv, L. Zhu & Y. Ma, Phys. Rev. B 82, 094116 (2010) and Comput. Phys. Commun. 183, 2063 (2012) (CALYPSO); D. J. Wales & J. P. K. Doye, J. Phys. Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) (basin hopping)

tabu.name: Tabu basin hopping
tabu.en: Basin hopping steered by a tabu memory of every local minimum it has found (energy-binned hash plus a species-resolved distance fingerprint, so recognising a minimum costs no extra force calls). Minima are accepted by a Metropolis test on E + lambda*log(1+visits) with a short recency tabu list; falling back into a known minimum enlarges the next perturbation, repeated revisits trigger restarts from random structures or rarely used low-energy archive minima, and relaxations that are about to end in a stored minimum are stopped early. Cluster moves relocate the atoms with the highest per-atom NEP energy to the surface; what is new is that one memory steers acceptance, step size, restarts and relaxation cost at once (tabu search + energy-landscape paving + minima-hopping-style feedback).
tabu.zh: 由禁忌记忆引导的盆地跳跃（basin hopping）：算法记录已找到的每一个局部极小（按能量分箱的哈希加按元素区分的距离指纹，识别极小无需额外的力计算）。对 E + λ·log(1+访问次数) 做 Metropolis 接受判据并配合短期禁忌表；落回已知极小时增大下一次扰动，反复重访则从随机结构或很少使用的低能存档极小重新开始，即将收敛到已知极小的弛豫会被提前终止。团簇移动按每原子 NEP 能量把结合最弱的原子重新放到表面；新颖之处在于同一份记忆同时控制接受、步长、重启和弛豫成本（禁忌搜索 + 能量景观铺平 + 极小跳跃式反馈）。

Chem. A 101, 5111 (1997) [basin hopping]; Hansmann & Wille, Phys. Rev. Lett. 88, 068105 (2002) [energy landscape paving]; Goedecker, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 9911 (2004) [history feedback of minima hopping]; Garivier & Moulines, ALT 2011, LNCS 6925, 174 [discounted UCB bandits]; Shao, Cheng & Cai, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1693 (2004) and Takeuchi, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 46, 2066 (2006) [surface relocation of high-energy atoms]

uspex.name: USPEX evolutionary algorithm
uspex.en: Generational evolutionary algorithm in the style of USPEX: a population of 10-30 locally relaxed structures (2 x number of search atoms) evolves by spatial heredity (~50%; a random plane or crystal slab cuts two fitness-ranked parents and their halves are combined, with a weighted-average lattice for crystals), new random structures (~20%), soft mutation along the softest vibrational mode of a bond-hardness spring model (~20%), swaps of unlike atoms (multi-element systems) and random lattice strain (bulk). The best 60% of the distinct structures are parents and the best 15% are kept unchanged; duplicates are removed with Oganov-Valle fingerprints (crystals) or distance fingerprints (clusters). This is a standard baseline that uses the USPEX default operator mix and parameter values. The search restarts when the best structure has not improved for n_search generations.
uspex.zh: USPEX 风格的代际进化算法：由 10-30 个（搜索原子数的 2 倍）经局部弛豫的结构组成种群，通过以下算子产生下一代：空间遗传（约 50%，用随机平面或晶体切片切分两个按能量排序选出的父代并拼接，晶体的晶格取两者的随机加权平均）、随机新结构（约 20%）、沿键硬度弹簧模型最软振动模式的软模突变（约 20%）、不同元素原子交换（多元素体系）以及随机晶格应变（体相）。不重复结构中能量最低的 60% 作为父代，最好的 15% 直接保留到下一代；晶体用 Oganov-Valle 指纹、团簇用距离指纹剔除重复结构。这是采用 USPEX 默认算子比例和参数值的标准基线方法。若最优结构连续 n_search 代没有改进，搜索重新开始。
